title: Superstition Mountains
description: Rock spires, saguaro and open desert in the Superstition Mountains of Arizona.

photos.title: Spires under heavy cloud
photos.alt: Red rock spires on a boulder-strewn slope beneath dark clouds and a patch of blue sky
photos.description: Heavy cloud gathers over a line of spires in the Superstition Mountains, with one last break of blue at its edge.

photos.title: Saguaro and boulder
photos.alt: A saguaro with its arms crowned by flower buds, beside a large red boulder above a wide desert basin
photos.description: Seen from high ground, the desert floor runs out to layered blue ranges behind a budding saguaro.

photos.title: Trail to the mountain
photos.alt: A gravel trail curving through dry golden grass toward a dark wall of cliffs
photos.description: The massif stands in shadow at the end of the path, its cliff face lined against a clear sky.

photos.title: Silver leaves, gold grass
photos.alt: A silvery-leaved desert plant standing among tall dry golden grass under a blue sky
photos.description: A close look at the desert floor, where pale leaves catch the light between stalks of dry grass.

photos.title: Sun behind the rock
photos.alt: The sun haloed beside the top of a rock outcrop, with spires beyond
photos.description: Backlit rock in the foreground and sunlit cliffs beyond, under a sky of broken cloud.

photos.title: Saguaro against the sun
photos.alt: A tall single-stemmed saguaro with a scarred trunk standing in dry grass, sun glaring behind it
photos.description: One saguaro rises straight into the glare, with boulders and rock towers to either side.

photos.title: Red crags
photos.alt: Rugged red rock crags on a ridge overlooking a golden desert plain and distant ranges
photos.description: From the ridge the land drops away to a broad plain and a long line of hazy mountains.

photos.title: Cairn
photos.alt: A tall cone of stacked red and grey stones on a gravel clearing between rock outcrops
photos.description: Loose stones piled into a single mound, set against streaked cloud.

photos.title: Cliffs and spires
photos.alt: Sheer cliffs and pointed rock spires above a pale scree slope, with white cloud behind
photos.description: Close under the mountain, where the spires stand apart from the main cliff.

photos.title: Branches against the sky
photos.alt: Silhouetted branches of a desert shrub covered in small fuzzy white tufts against a blue sky
photos.description: A shrub seen from below, its small tufts glowing where the light passes through them.

photos.title: Overcast basin
photos.alt: A wide desert basin under heavy grey cloud, with cloud shadows and a long mountain range
photos.description: Looking out from high ground on a grey day, the valley floor mottled by shadow.

photos.title: Cholla
photos.alt: A spiny cholla cactus in the foreground, with saguaros and distant ranges under heavy cloud
photos.description: Cholla close at hand and saguaros on the slope behind, the sky thick with cloud.

photos.title: Through the rocks
photos.alt: A jagged grey ridge and distant desert framed between two tall walls of rock
photos.description: A gap between boulders opens onto the ridges and the plain far below.

photos.title: The ridge line
photos.alt: A three-armed saguaro in desert brush before the cliffs and spires of the Superstition ridge
photos.description: The main ridge of the Superstitions, seen across scrub with a saguaro in the foreground.
